title: Cloud Security: overpayment refund
content:
Cloud Security overpayment refund is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.

Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced.

Use original-payment refund methods, require at least minimum voluntary cash refund, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out.

A smaller positive balance remains on account.

Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure.

Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund.

A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable refund action, authoritative system records must establish: The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The evidence is bound to the same Security event reference, customer request reference, original source event reference, Security contract reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Can a refund go to a third party?**

A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

## Refund limit

Hypothetical inputs: the negative net receivable has magnitude USD 60, and the source payment has USD 40 remaining after prior returns and refunds. Available refund is USD 40. A request for USD 45 is refused, without silently reducing it.
